title: P5: read a DuckDB file through dap.db_reader
rationale: Pins dap.db_reader end to end on the committed DuckDB fixture: native read-only attach, copy into the session and the declared column types.
notes: fixture.duckdb is generated by tests/goldens-native/data/make_db_fixtures.py (table items, 3 rows). The DuckDB driver needs no extension, so the golden stays offline; the SQLite twin is covered by DbReaderExecutorTest and tests/coverage/db_reader.json (requires sqlite_scanner).
